items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: they picked up Claude Williams ... and put him in the band ... And we all knew Claude was very, very temperamental.

ctx.x: Well, why did he get Claude Williams

Yeah. But, remember, as I said before, they picked up Claude Williams -- I don't know, he'd been with Benny Moten, I think. But, anyway, they got him at the last minute, and put him in the band when they got ready -- enlarged the band. And we all knew Claude was very, very temperamental.
Oh, well, there was some reason for that.
